description: Draw a table as an image, or a pivot table when rows/values are given (cross-tabulation, sums by category). Data [{...}] objects with the same fields; rows, columns and values name the fields to pivot. For an Excel file use the Excel link any chart tool returns. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

brandTheme.description: Name of a brand theme saved on the user's account (their colours and footer), only when the user asks for their theme. Or "colorblind" for colours that people with colour-vision deficiency can tell apart (anyone can use it).

columns.description: Column header fields, used to specify the order of columns. For regular tables, this determines column order; for pivot tables, this is used for column grouping.

data.description: Data for spreadsheet, an array of objects where each object represents a row. Keys are column names and values can be string, number, or null. Such as, [{ name: 'John', age: 30 }, { name: 'Jane', age: 25 }].

height.description: Set the height of chart, default is 400.

rows.description: Row header fields for pivot table. When 'rows' or 'values' is provided, the spreadsheet will be rendered as a pivot table.

theme.description: Set the theme for the spreadsheet, optional, default is 'default'.

values.description: Value fields for pivot table. When 'rows' or 'values' is provided, the spreadsheet will be rendered as a pivot table.

width.description: Set the width of chart, default is 600.
